industry: Treasure Island Industrial Corporation is a Cebuano-based conglomerate founded in the 50’s. Treasure Island is now a prominent player in local commerce and our products are becoming household names. The decades have seen Treasure Island’s expansion into many other areas of industry mostly trading and repacking of solvents. Chemical and Paints Division have 3 major Sections, the Chemical Section for manufacturing of variety of chemicals such as (varnish, paint thinner, lacquer thinner, adhesives and paint removers), the Paint Section for manufacturing of paints (water-based and solvent-based) and the Powder Mix Section for concrete surface coating. Our company eventually created a subsidiary to manufacture packaging materials like corrugated cardboard and styrofoam boxes, tin cans, and shrinkable plastic seal caps and labels. Most recently, Treasure Island has gone into the production of quality house and automotive paints aptly named Island Paints. Extending further, we have linked up internationally with Transocean Marine Paints, distributing specially formulated paints for ships and other marine craft.
